Name.description: The display name of the browser.

ExePath.description: The path to the browser executable. Use LaunchArgs to pass arguments to the executable.

CustomIconPath.description: The path to a custom icon for the browser. This must be a .ico file.

LaunchArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the browser executable. Use {url} to insert the URL.

Hidden.description: If true, the browser will not be shown in the browser list.

AlternateLaunches.description: Alternate ways to launch the browser. These will be shown in the browser list through a context menu.

LaunchUnderMouse.description: If true, the browser will be launched under the mouse cursor.

NoWhiteBorder.description: If true, the white border around the browser window will be removed.

RuleMatching.description: If true, Enables Rule Matching feature with the rules defined in the 'Rulesets' Property.

BackgroundType.description: The type of background to use for the browser window. mica, acrylic, or solid.

WindowSize.description: The size of the Hurl browser selector window. define as an array of two integers for width and height.

QuickView.description: Settings for the Quick View link preview feature.

LaunchMode.description: Determines whether Quick View opens the built-in WebView preview or launches a configured browser profile.

ModifierKeys.description: Modifier keys required to trigger Quick View.

BrowserId.description: The browser Id to launch when LaunchMode is Browser.

AlternateLaunchId.description: The alternate launch Id to use when LaunchMode is Browser. Null uses the browser's default launch.

AdditionalBrowserArguments.description: Additional browser arguments passed to the WebView2 environment.

BrowserExtensionsEnabled.description: If true, enables Microsoft Edge browser extensions in WebView2 Quick View.

TrackingPrevention.description: Tracking prevention level used by the WebView2 profile.

Rulesets.description: Rulesets to apply to URLs. Each Ruleset can contain multiple rules and One browser can be assigned to multiple Rulesets.

items.description: The URL pattern, optionally prefixed with s$, r$, or d$. The prefix selects how the pattern is matched; an unprefixed value is treated as a simple string. s$ = simple string, r$ = regex, d$ = domain.

BrowserId.description: The Id of the browser to launch for this Ruleset. This should match the Id property of a browser in the Browsers array.

RulesetName.description: The name of the Ruleset. This should ideally be unique.

AlternateLaunchId.description: The Id of the Alternate Launch to use. Null or omitted uses the browser's default launch.
